name: Smart Playlists
author: Kyle-Hosman
summary: SMART PLAYLIST on the browse screen: live BPM and harmonic-key matches for the playing track, plus saved filters.
description:
Tap SMART PLAYLIST on the browse/playlist screen for live related tracks from both USBs. Auto uses the sole playing deck; choose a reference when several play. Adjust BPM tolerance and compatible-key filtering. Unknown reference key is labelled BPM only. Turn the knob to scroll all scanned matches.

The button and list are a read-only overlay. Load tracks in the native browser. Saved filters remain in the mod page. Scans cover up to 20,000 tracks per USB and report limits. No USB writes, audio changes, firmware patches or network.
